evals.name: House-style product draft
evals.description: Test that the skill drafts a new distributor product in full Bay State house style
evals.prompt: Draft this new distributor product for our store: Brand: Victor, Product: Hi-Pro Plus Dry Dog Food, Size: 40 lb, UPC: 074501111112, category: Dog Food / Dry Food, page: Dog Food, images: victor-hi-pro-plus-40lb.jpg plus 2 alternates.
expected_output: Name follows BRAND product size pattern (Victor Hi-Pro Plus Dry Dog Food 40 lb)
SKU and GTIN both set to the 12-digit UPC
FileName is the slugified lowercase name with .html
ProductField1 is not stamped by classification; ProductField16 may use the explicit Brand input as a separate draft field, but Brand is never classifier output

Determines the canonical Category / Product Type pair for review from product evidence rather than copying siblings; emits PF24/25 only if exact frozen approved website mappings exist, otherwise reports the gap and does not invent values
ProductOnPages proposes the Dog Food page only with a verification step against the defined pages table (never invents page names)
SearchKeywords follow the Name, breadcrumb pattern
Images use victor/ subdirectory paths with numbered sequence
ProductDisabled is checked (never pre-enabled)

evals.name: Convention-violation review
evals.description: Test that the skill flags house-style violations and treats open questions correctly
evals.prompt: Review this draft against our conventions: Name '40 lb victor hi-pro plus', SKU 074501111112, no GTIN, brand 'victor' lowercase, no PF24/25, Availability in_stock, ProductDisabled uncheck.
expected_output: Flags name order violation (size first, brand not leading)
Flags missing GTIN mirror of the UPC SKU
Flags lowercase brand as a data error to normalize
Does not treat Brand as classification output; if normalizing the separate draft field, uses authoritative manufacturer/distributor casing
Reports unresolved canonical pair or unavailable PF24/25 projection as a review/readiness gap; does not fabricate a mapping or ShopSite value
Flags pre-enabled ProductDisabled as a workflow violation (owner enables on ShopSite after review)
Mentions the instock vs in_stock discrepancy as an open note, not a failure

evals.name: Taxonomy question
evals.description: Test that the skill answers taxonomy questions from PF24/25 authority
evals.prompt: Where should a new grain-free salmon dry dog food go in our taxonomy, and what fields carry that?
expected_output: Explains that classification selects one canonical Category / Product Type pair from the versioned taxonomy and product evidence; PF24/25 are projected only through exact frozen approved mappings, never guessed or copied from messy siblings
Distinguishes native XML <ProductType> (Tangible/Download fulfillment) from the canonical Product Type facet at ProductField25
Explains ProductOnPages carries the ShopSite page assignment alongside PF24/25
Assigns only pages from the defined ShopSite page list and fails validation on unknown page names
References the validation checklist for the remaining required fields
Notes page-tree redesign is out of scope for this skill (fields first)
